verdict.rationale: AWS documents public, per-service versioned APIs, such as the EC2 Query API with date-stamped versions and the Cost Explorer API. It also publishes machine-readable Smithy models for all public API services, and its CLI covers functionality equivalent to the console, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI-format spec (probes 404; the models are Smithy/botocore JSON on GitHub), and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: for all public AWS API services
**Version**: The API version to use. For the Amazon EC2 API, the version is 2016-11-15.
